status.note: Together's press page and blog list no acquisition of the company; its latest company announcement is the July 2026 Series C.

retention.value: Not stored by default for new organizations; no period stated when prompt storage is on
retention.quote: New organizations start with zero data retention (ZDR) enabled.
retention.note: The page states the default for new organizations only. With prompt storage on, it says prompts and responses are stored and can be deleted at any time, and gives no retention period; the privacy policy gives none either.

zdr.quote: Together AI enables zero data retention (ZDR) by default for new organizations.
zdr.note: The page states the default for new organizations only; an organization with prompt storage turned on turns it off to enable ZDR, which also turns off passthrough models.

zdr_how.value: Enabled by default for new organizations; otherwise an organization admin turns off Prompt storage in the Privacy section of Organization Settings
zdr_how.quote: If your organization has prompt storage turned on, turn it off to enable ZDR.
zdr_how.note: The privacy and security docs page says only organization admins can change the toggles in the Privacy section of Organization Settings.

training.quote: We do not use any data collected from you to train our models without your explicit opt-in and consent.
training.note: When prompt storage is on, stored prompts and responses may be used for product improvements.

soc2.quote: The latest SOC 2 Type 2 report is now available.
soc2.note: Trust centre update published June 17, 2026; the report itself is behind an access request.

attestations.quote: I am very pleased to announce that Together AI is officially ISO 27001:2022 certified!!!
attestations.note: Together's July 2025 blog post also says it adheres to HIPAA requirements and signs BAAs with partners, without naming an attestation.

subprocessors.quote: Amazon Web Services • Hosting and cloud infrastructure
subprocessors.note: The page is a list of 35 rows, not prose; the quote is its first row and the value is every name listed.

regions.quote: For select serverless models, geo-specific inference keeps inference processing in the United States, with no GPUs to provision.
regions.note: Applies only to requests sent to us-api.together.ai; where the default endpoint runs is not stated, and the docs say EU regions are available for VPC deployments on dedicated endpoints.

funding.quote: Today, I am excited to announce the next milestone in our journey with Series C funding of $800 million from an incredible group of investors including Aramco Ventures, NVIDIA, Vista Equity, General Catalyst, Emergence Capital, SE Ventures, Pegatron, Salesforce Ventures, March Capital, DTCP Growth, Lux Capital, Geodesic, PSP Partners, and others.
